security_audit.summary: The audit found no prompt injection, hidden malware intent, or undisclosed data exfiltration in SKILL.md. Most static findings are markdown formatting artifacts, while the real risks are disclosed RunComfy CLI execution, third-party model API transfer, and API token storage.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is required for the skill workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command examples explicit, avoid shell interpolation, and tell users to inspect RunComfy CLI installation sources before global installation.

remediation.issue: Prompts and source image URLs are sent to a hosted RunComfy model API.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit confidential images or private URLs unless their RunComfy account and data policy permit it.

remediation.issue: RunComfy authentication stores an API token in a hidden configuration file by default.
remediation.suggestion: Document token rotation, file permission checks, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN option for CI environments.

content.user_title: Edit Images with Flux Kontext Pro
content.value_statement: Precise image edits often fail when prompts are vague or the wrong model is selected. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use Flux Kontext Pro through RunComfy with focused prompts and clear boundaries.
actual_capabilities: Routes explicit Flux Kontext image-edit requests to the RunComfy model workflow.
Documents the RunComfy CLI command and the Flux Kontext Pro edit endpoint.
Explains required inputs: prompt, source image URL, optional aspect ratio, and optional seed.
Provides prompting guidance for preservation-led and single-change image edits.
Compares when to use Flux Kontext versus related image models.
Documents expected exit codes, token storage behavior, and outbound endpoints.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account and local RunComfy CLI setup.
Uses one public source image URL per edit request.
Sends prompts and image URLs to RunComfy's hosted model API.
Does not generate images from scratch or handle multi-image edits.

use_cases.title: Refine a product image
use_cases.description: Change label text, color, or a small object while preserving the original product shape and lighting.

use_cases.title: Create campaign variants
use_cases.description: Use a fixed seed and focused prompt to test small changes across similar creative directions.

use_cases.title: Choose the right image model
use_cases.description: Compare Flux Kontext with sibling image workflows before sending a request to RunComfy.

prompt_templates.title: Basic local edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one visible change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext to edit this image: keep the main subject unchanged and add [specific object or change]. The source image URL is [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Preserve identity and framing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro. Keep [identity, pose, framing, lighting] unchanged. Change only [target detail]. Use this source image: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Product text replacement
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro to keep the product, label shape, camera angle, and lighting unchanged. Replace only the text [old text] with [new text]. Source image: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Reproducible variant series
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext Pro with seed [number]. Keep [stable elements] unchanged and apply this single edit: [edit]. Use aspect ratio [ratio] if supported. Source image: [URL].

output_examples.input: A portrait needs one prop added while preserving the person's face, pose, and clothing.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects Flux Kontext, writes a preservation-led edit prompt, and prepares a RunComfy CLI request for the provided image URL.

output_examples.input: A bottle label should change from one brand word to another without altering the bottle or lighting.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends a single focused text-replacement prompt and warns that embedded text edits may need comparison with another model.

output_examples.input: A user asks for multiple reference images and a new scene from scratch.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that Flux Kontext is not the best fit and routes the request to a multi-image or text-to-image workflow.

best_practices: Use one clear edit instruction and state preserved elements first.
Pass only public image URLs that are safe to share with RunComfy.
Use seeds when comparing controlled variants of the same edit.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated changes in one prompt.
Do not use this skill for confidential images without data-sharing approval.
Do not pass multiple source images or ask it to create from scratch.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant use Flux 1 Kontext Pro on RunComfy for precise single-image edits.

faq.question: Does it require RunComfy?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow depends on the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and the hosted model API.

faq.question: Can it edit more than one image at a time?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow is for one source image. Use another model workflow for multi-image edits.

faq.question: Can I use private image URLs?
faq.answer: Only if your privacy policy allows RunComfy to fetch and process them. Public or approved URLs are safest.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What is the main security concern?
faq.answer: The workflow runs an external CLI and sends prompts plus image URLs to a third-party hosted model API.
